salary_details.details: The stipend payable to apprentices is governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprentices Rules, 1992, and applicable amendments/guidelines. In addition to the statutory stipend, IOCL (MD), NR will pay ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses. For Graduate and Technician Apprentices, a portion of the stipend is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). Trade Apprentices (NAPS apprentices) receive their full stipend directly from IOCL (MD), NR. These arrangements are subject to change as per government/BOAT/NAPS guidelines issued from time to time. A specific fixed monthly stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

selection_process: Online Application: Candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal and applying against the notification are considered for selection. There is no written test or interview. Merit List: Prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the respective post. Ties are resolved first by earlier date of birth

and then by higher marks in matriculation if the date of birth is also the same. Preference: Given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test: Candidates must be adjudged medically fit as per IOCL's pre-engagement medical standards. Offer of Engagement: Issued to candidates who successfully clear document verification and the medical fitness test. Up to ₹3
000 is reimbursed towards expenses incurred for pre-engagement medical tests/investigations
how_to_apply: Register as a Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice on the applicable portal for your state: Trade Apprentice (ITI): NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in Technician Apprentice (Diploma): NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in Graduate Apprentice: NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Ensure your profile (personal details, educational details, category, aggregate percentage) is complete and correct before applying; corrections must be made through the NAPS/NATS office.
Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003.
After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c

Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained.
Apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to rejection of the application.
important_instructions: Candidates must have a valid, active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on NAPS/NATS, and 100% completion of their profile. Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS. Candidates must possess a PAN card, an Aadhaar card, and an active bank account with a cheque book (same account as updated on the NATS portal), seeded to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, along with an updated APAAR ID and e-KYC verification on the NATS portal. SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats will be considered only if they meet the standards applicable to General category candidates. Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange/Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD must apply only through the NAPS/NATS portal. The apprenticeship period is 12 months for all disciplines. On completion, IOCL has no obligation to offer regular employment, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Ex-apprentices get an equal opportunity to apply for future openings like any other candidate. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification; any false/incorrect/suppressed information detected at any stage - even after engagement - can lead to cancellation or termination. Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per Corporation requirements and all relevant rules/policies/guidelines. The decision of the management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation of the process; filling of seats is entirely at the discretion of management, and no claim will arise if seats remain unfilled. Incomplete applications, applications in any other mode, or those received after the last date will be treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: IOCL has notified a total of 433 provisional apprentice seats across 9 states/UTs in the Northern Region. Seats are grouped by discipline-code cluster - Technician Apprentice (Discipline Codes 101–106), Trade Apprentice/ITI (Discipline Codes 107–111), Graduate Apprentice (Discipline Code 112), and Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator, both Fresher and Skill Certificate Holders (Discipline Codes 113–114) - exactly as structured in the official notification, since category-wise reservation figures are published at the cluster level rather than per individual discipline code. The table below reproduces the official state-wise seat distribution with category-wise reservation (UR, EWS, SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD), as prescribed by the applicable state/UT reservation policy. Reservation Break-up Note on PwBD reservation: PwBD reservation for Graduate Apprentice and Data Entry Operator (Fresher & Skill Certificate Holders) disciplines is applied horizontally across all categories, as per government guidelines. Candidates with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Discipline Codes 101–111 (Technician and ITI Trade categories). PwBD engagement is limited to Low Vision/Blind, Hard of Hearing/Deaf, specified Musculoskeletal disabilities/Dwarfism/Acid attack victims/Cerebral Palsy/Leprosy cured, and Multiple Disabilities (a combination of the above); other disability categories have not been included, citing the hazardous nature of the industry. The Number of Vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: The following original documents, along with self-attested copies, must be furnished at document verification: Matriculation (Class X) mark sheet/certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education - the only acceptable proof of date of birth. Latest caste certificate (for reserved category candidates) in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a competent authority. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued on or after 01.09.2025 (not more than 12 months old as on 31.08.2026), for candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation. Certificate from the institute confirming the candidate pursued the course through regular mode, with the year of passing. Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering, as applicable. Final ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering certificate issued by the respective Board/Authority/Institute. Copy of the first page of the bank passbook of the Aadhaar-seeded account, Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a cancelled cheque leaf. Pre-engagement medical fitness certificate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register as a Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice on the applicable portal for your state: Trade Apprentice (ITI): NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in Technician Apprentice (Diploma): NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in Graduate Apprentice: NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in Ensure your profile (personal details, educational details, category, aggregate percentage) is complete and correct before applying; corrections must be made through the NAPS/NATS office. Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003. After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained. Apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must have a valid, active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on NAPS/NATS, and 100% completion of their profile. Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS. Candidates must possess a PAN card, an Aadhaar card, and an active bank account with a cheque book (same account as updated on the NATS portal), seeded to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, along with an updated APAAR ID and e-KYC verification on the NATS portal. SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats will be considered only if they meet the standards applicable to General category candidates. Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange/Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD must apply only through the NAPS/NATS portal. The apprenticeship period is 12 months for all disciplines. On completion, IOCL has no obligation to offer regular employment, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Ex-apprentices get an equal opportunity to apply for future openings like any other candidate. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification; any false/incorrect/suppressed information detected at any stage - even after engagement - can lead to cancellation or termination. Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per Corporation requirements and all relevant rules/policies/guidelines. The decision of the management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation of the process; filling of seats is entirely at the discretion of management, and no claim will arise if seats remain unfilled. Incomplete applications, applications in any other mode, or those received after the last date will be treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate.

faq.question: Q1. What is IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advt. No. IOCL/MKTG/NR/APPR/2026-27/1) by IndianOil Corporation Limited, Marketing Division, Northern Region, for engaging Technician, Graduate, and Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 433 provisional apprentice seats across Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply through the NAPS/NATS portal and submit the Microsoft Office Form is 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IOCL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: It varies by discipline code: Class X with a relevant 2-year ITI course for Trade Apprentice posts, a 3-year Diploma in Engineering for Technician Apprentice posts, a graduate degree in any discipline for Graduate Apprentice, and Class 12th pass (plus a skill certificate for Discipline Code 114) for Data Entry Operator posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 24 years as on 31.08.2026, with age relaxation of up to 3 years for OBC-NCL, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention an application fee for this apprenticeship engagement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for IOCL Apprentices?
faq.answer: Stipend is paid as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprentices Rules, 1992, plus ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses from IOCL. A specific fixed stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is purely merit-based on the percentage of marks in the qualifying examination — there is no written test or interview. Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification and a pre-engagement medical fitness test.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online via the NAPS portal (for ITI/Data Entry Operator posts) or NATS portal (for Technician/Graduate posts), then submit the mandatory Microsoft Office Form with your location preferences, both by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one discipline code?
faq.answer: No. Candidates can apply for only one discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
